title: COVID Blood Processing for scRNAseq
author: Peter Szabo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bjm6kk9e
materials: Inclubate samples at Room temperature for 00:20:00 .

steps.title: Prepare DPBS‑EDTA solution
steps.instruction: Make DPBS‑EDTA solution in a bottle of DPBS according to the provided table.

steps.title: Place sample box in biosafety cabinet
steps.instruction: Put the sample box inside the biosafety cabinet.

steps.title: Decontaminate sample containers
steps.instruction: Remove samples from the box and containment bags, discard the bags, spray each sample container with >70 % ethanol and wipe down.

steps.title: Record whole blood volume
steps.instruction: Measure and record the total volume of whole blood to be processed (in mL).

steps.title: Centrifuge blood and collect plasma
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the whole blood at 400 × g, 20 °C for 10 min in the anti‑coagulant tubes. Remove the plasma layer to cryovials without disturbing red blood cells. Add the same plasma volume to each cryovial, record the number of vials and volume per vial. Ensure cryovials are decontaminated before removal from the cabinet.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in DPBS‑EDTA
steps.instruction: Add the same volume of DPBS‑EDTA that was removed as plasma back to the blood tube and pipette to mix.

steps.title: Add RosetteSep cocktail
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL RosetteSep Cocktail per 1 mL of blood directly to the tube and pipette to mix.

steps.title: Dilute sample to 25 mL
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to a 50 mL tube and dilute with DPBS‑EDTA up to a final volume of 25 mL.

steps.title: Add Ficoll‑Paque to tube
steps.instruction: Aliquot 15 mL Ficoll‑Paque Media PLUS into the same 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Layer blood over Ficoll
steps.instruction: Using the slow setting on the pipette gun, gently layer the blood/DPBS‑EDTA mixture on top of the 15 mL Ficoll‑Paque, taking care not to disturb the interface.

steps.title: Centrifuge for mononuclear layer
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm the centrifuge to 20 °C, then spin at 1200 × g, 20 °C for 20 min with no brake and acceleration setting 4.

steps.title: Harvest mononuclear cell layer
steps.instruction: Remove the mononuclear cell layer from each tube and transfer to a new 50 mL tube, avoiding the underlying Ficoll layer (granulocytes). Pulling from the plasma layer is acceptable.

steps.title: Wash PBMCs – first spin
steps.instruction: Top the PBMCs with cold DPBS‑EDTA to a total volume of 40 mL (at least 2–3 × the cell volume) and centrifuge at 400 × g, 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Platelet spin wash
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, top the tube to 40 mL with cold DPBS‑EDTA, and centrifuge at 120 × g, 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in DPBS
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant (pellet may be loose) and resuspend the cell pellet in 4 mL Dulbecco’s Phosphate Buffered Saline (DPBS).

steps.title: Stain with Solution 13
steps.instruction: Add 0.05 mL sample, 0.05 mL DPBS, and 0.005 mL Solution 13 to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube; incubate 2 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Fix cells with Cytofix
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 mL BD Cytofix Fixation Buffer to the tube; incubate 30 min at room temperature and protect from light.

steps.title: Count cells on NC‑Slide
steps.instruction: Aliquot 0.01 mL of the sample to a well of an NC‑Slide A8, count on the NC‑3000, and record cell number (cells/mL) and viability (%).

steps.title: Aliquot cells for downstream
steps.instruction: Aliquot up to 2 × 10⁷ cells into a 5 mL Falcon round‑bottom tube and place on ice for subsequent clean‑up.

steps.title: Cryopreserve cells
steps.instruction: Freeze up to 1 × 10⁸ cells in approximately 1 × 10⁷ aliquots (1 mL each) using Cryostor CS10 Medium, a Mr. Frosty, and a –80 °C freezer. Record number of vials and cells per vial.

steps.title: Centrifuge single‑cell suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the single‑cell suspension at 400 × g, 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in DPBS‑EDTA
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 50 µL DPBS‑EDTA.

steps.title: Block Fc receptors
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL Human TruStain FcX to the suspension; incubate 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Stain with biotinylated antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL biotinylated anti‑CD66b and 10 µL biotinylated anti‑CD235ab; incubate 30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Add BioMag Plus beads
steps.instruction: While the suspension is incubating, add 0.2 mL BioMag Plus Streptavidin Beads to a 5 mL Falcon round‑bottom tube.

steps.title: Wash beads with DPBS‑EDTA
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL DPBS‑EDTA to the beads and place on a magnet for 5 min.

steps.title: Magnet incubation of beads
steps.instruction: Remove all supernatant, take the tube off the magnet, and resuspend the beads in 0.1 mL DPBS‑EDTA.

steps.title: Add DPBS‑EDTA and centrifuge
steps.instruction: After step 25, add 3 mL DPBS‑EDTA to the single‑cell suspension and centrifuge at 400 × g, 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Resuspend in beads and incubate
steps.instruction: Resuspend the single‑cell suspension in the BioMag Plus beads (from step 28) and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Magnet wash with DPBS
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL DPBS to the tube and place on a magnet for 5 min.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to new tube
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and transfer it to a separate 5 mL Falcon round‑bottom tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension at 400 × g, 4 °C for 5 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend in Dead Cell Removal beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 0.1 mL Dead Cell Removal Microbeads, mix well, and incubate at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Prepare MACS MS column
steps.instruction: While the suspension is incubating, place an MS Column onto the MACS Multistand and rinse with 0.5 mL 1× Binding Buffer solution.

steps.title: Apply suspension to column
steps.instruction: After incubation, apply the cell suspension to the MS Column; collect the flow‑through in a 5 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Rinse column with Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Rinse the column with 1.5 mL 1× Binding Buffer and collect the rinse in the same tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected suspension at 400 × g, 4 °C for 5 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend final pellet and count
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final cell pellet in 0.5 mL DPBS and count cells.

steps.title: Final staining, fixation, and count
steps.instruction: Add 0.05 mL sample, 0.05 mL DPBS, and 0.005 mL Solution 13 to a 1.5 mL tube; incubate 2 min at room temperature. Then add 0.1 mL BD Cytofix Fixation Buffer; incubate 30 min at room temperature, protected from light. Aliquot 0.01 mL to an NC‑Slide A8, count on the NC‑3000, and record number and viability.

steps.title: Run 10X Chromium protocol
steps.instruction: Follow the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3’ Reagent Kits v3.1 User Guide (Rev D) for encapsulation of the prepared cells.
